knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(doBy)
library(patchwork)

# plot setting
large <- theme(legend.title = element_text(size=20),
        legend.text = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text = element_text(size=20),
        strip.text = element_text(size=20))
# Standard error function
se <- function(x, ...)sd(x, ...)/sqrt(length(x))
```

# DAR and alpha diveristy

```{r}
# Generalized Additive Mixed-effect Model (GAMM)
load("../Rdata/cross_v_r2_top.rda")
p1 <- cbind(Model = "GAMM", perf_t %>% ldply(.id = "Variable"))
# Random Forest (RF)
load("../Rdata/rf_concentration.rda")
p2 <- cbind(Model = "RF", lapply(rf, FUN=function(x)x$results[row.names(x$bestTune),]) %>% ldply(.id="Variable"))
# Generalized Boosted Regression Modeling (GBM)
load("../Rdata/gb_concentration.rda")
p3 <- cbind(Model = "GBM", lapply(gb, FUN=function(x)x$results[row.names(x$bestTune),]) %>% ldply(.id="Variable"))
# Bagged Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS)
load("../Rdata/bm_concentration.rda")
p4 <- cbind(Model = "MARS", lapply(bm, FUN=function(x)x$results[row.names(x$bestTune),]) %>% ldply(.id="Variable")) 
perf <- rbind(p1, p2[,-3], p3[,-3:-6], p4[, -3:-4])

kable(perf, caption="Accuracy and performance of the model by 10-fold cross validation") %>% kable_classic
```

```{r}
perf$Model <- factor(perf$Model, levels=c("GAMM", "RF", "GBM", "MARS"))
f1 <- ggplot(data = perf, aes(x=Variable, y=Rsquared, ymin=Rsquared-RsquaredSD, ymax=Rsquared+RsquaredSD, fill=Model, colour=Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge")+
  geom_errorbar(stat="identity", position="dodge")+
  labs(y=expression("Cross-validated"~R^2), x="", title = "(a)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("DAR", expression(""^0*italic(D)), 
                  expression(""^1*italic(D)), 
                  expression(""^2*italic(D)), 
                  expression(""^1*italic(E)), 
                  expression(""^2*italic(E))
                  ))+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()+
  scale_colour_viridis_d()+
  theme_bw() %+replace% large
```

# Individual species

```{r}
# Random Forest (RF)
load("../Rdata/allSpp_rf_concentration.rda")
p2 <- cbind(Model = "RF", lapply(rf, FUN=function(x)x$results[row.names(x$bestTune),]) %>% ldply(.id="Variable"))
# Generalized Boosted Regression Modeling (GBM)
load("../Rdata/allSpp_gb_concentration.rda")
p3 <- cbind(Model = "GBM", lapply(gb, FUN=function(x)x$results[row.names(x$bestTune),]) %>% ldply(.id="Variable"))
# Bagged Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS)
load("../Rdata/allSpp_bm_concentration.rda")
p4 <- cbind(Model = "MARS", lapply(bm, FUN=function(x)x$results[row.names(x$bestTune),]) %>% ldply(.id="Variable")) 

perf <- rbind(p2[,-3], p3[,-3:-6], p4[, -3:-4])

kable(perf, caption="Accuracy and performance of the model by 10-fold cross validation") %>% kable_classic

kable(summary_by(data=perf, Rsquared~Model, FUN=c(mean, sd, se), na.rm=T), caption="Average cross-validated R2") %>% kable_classic
```

```{r}
perf$Variable <- factor(perf$Variable, levels=p2$Variable[order(p2$Rsquared)])
perf$Model <- factor(perf$Model, levels=c("RF", "GBM", "MARS"))
f2 <- ggplot(data = perf, aes(x=Model, y=Rsquared, ymin=Rsquared-RsquaredSD, ymax=Rsquared+RsquaredSD, fill=Variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge")+
  geom_boxplot(aes(group=Model), fill="transparent", width=0.5)+
  labs(y=expression("Species Cross-validated"~R^2), x="", title = "(b)")+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()+
  scale_colour_viridis_d()+
  theme_bw() %+replace% large %+replace% theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
f1/f2
```
